title: Minus 32 Million Words
description:
Acclaimed comic, actor and writer Sue Costello tracks her life growing up in a chaotic home in Dorchester and how it led her to a desperate need for fame and money, and to the final realization that her past does not have to become her future. Alternately heartbreaking and hilarious, the show combines Costello’s street- smart Boston take-no-prisoners wit with her ability to bring an audience to tears.

“Sue Costello’s charismatic performance is mesmerizing as you march with her through her teenage years on the Dorchester streets through her life in New York and Hollywood.” –Colin Quinn

Actress and comedian Sue Costello, a native of Boston, has had her own self-titled Fox sitcom, appeared in several hit movies, and performed her stand-up on Last Comic Standing. Her one-woman show, Minus 32 Million Words is a hilarious, brutally honest look at her chaotic upbringing in Dorchester, her even more chaotic show business career and how she survived it all with a lot of laughter and hope.

    I've been hoping for years that the A.R.T. would finally live up to its innate promise... but I've never fully enjoyed a production there. Things were either too strange-for-the-sake-of-strange (bobrauschenbergamerica) or just poorly executed (Donnie Darko, The Communist Dracula Pageant, The Seagull). Diane Paulus was brought in to shake things up and right off the bat, she's done it. The Donkey Show is NOT typical A.R.T. fare - the blue hairs who previously made up the bulk of the subscription base are no longer their target. Instead, the idea is to get a new generation of theater-goers interested in the various promises of "theater" and that's what this show does. Its debauched, its hilarious, its a lot of fun, and its wildly different from a "normal" show. Divisive? Absolutely. But if you have an open mind, you'll probably find it to be a lot of fun!
